02 / A LITTLE ABOUT ME

Good software starts
with understanding
the work.

John Russel Fabroa Engineer. Builder. Always learning.

I’m a software engineer working across enterprise applications and AI systems, based in Silang, Cavite. At TDK Philippines, I build software for the people behind manufacturing operations, from the interfaces they use to the data that drives their decisions.

My foundation is C# and .NET. I work across web applications, REST APIs, databases, and analytics, and bring AI integration and workflow automation into practical business problems.

As an Energy Productivity ASEAN Leader, I also coordinate regional digital initiatives with TDK Japan HQ. That work has taught me to care as much about clear communication and useful outcomes as the code itself.

EDUCATIONBS Information TechnologyMindoro State University, Calapan Campus2019–2023
